This is more in line with a feature request than a bug or documentation issue, as it is asking for new behavior to be implemented. input.body:
File: src/api/errors.ts

Introduce a feature to let users update their email addresses in their profiles. The current implementation returns a validation error when users attempt to change their email address. Enhance the profile update process to accept new email addresses, perhaps by sending a confirmation link to the new address. This update will help users transition smoothly when their email domain changes without needing to recreate accounts and reports.
